chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 268 - "On the Road": A Grim Journey Begins
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang sets his sights on the mysterious Pi County after hearing rumors of a “plague.” Amidst the journey’s grind, a small act of kindness offers a glimpse of the man he used to be.
og_title: A Fork in the Road for Li Huowang
og_description: Chapter 268 of Dao Gui Yi Xian finds the weary protagonist chasing whispers of a plague while a world of poverty grinds on around him.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian 268: The Road to Plague
twitter_description: Li Huowang hears of a strange plague in Pi County. Is it the lead he’s been looking for, or just another false hope on a long, hungry road?

lore_anchors.definition: A government-sponsored organization under the imperial board of war that manages supernatural disasters and hunts rogue cultivators.
A historical Chinese term for landless peasants who traveled with the harvest, selling their labor for a few days before moving on.
The ruling dynasty of the Dao-Twisted World where Li Huowang currently finds himself.
A simple, hearty dish that would be a luxury for the very poor, consisting of fatty, preserved pork steamed with rice.
The Chinese philosophical system of harmonizing people with their surrounding environment; here used colloquially to mean “bad energy” or “bad luck.”
